The
enzyme
(1-hydroxycyclohexan-1-yl)acetyl-CoA lyase
(
EC
4.1.3.35
)
catalyzes
the
chemical reaction
(1-hydroxycyclohexan-1-yl)acetyl-CoA
⇌
{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }
acetyl-CoA + cyclohexanone
Hence, this enzyme has one
substrate
, (1-hydroxycyclohexan-1-yl)acetyl-CoA, and two
products
,
acetyl-CoA
and
cyclohexanone
.
This enzyme belongs to the family of
lyases
, specifically the oxo-acid-lyases, which cleave carbon-carbon bonds.  The
systematic name
of this enzyme class is
(1-hydroxycyclohexan-1-yl)acetyl-CoA cyclohexanone-lyase (acetyl-CoA-forming)
. This enzyme is also called
(1-hydroxycyclohexan-1-yl)acetyl-CoA cyclohexanone-lyase
.
